intro: Tower Defense marks a desperate holdout against overwhelming numbers at a fortified position. While the frontline defenders maintain a temporary stalemate, mounting exhaustion threatens to collapse the defense without swift intervention.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.
Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.
My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
